about_p1: We handle tree service for homes and businesses around Asheboro.

reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: michael fry
reviews.text: Amazing owner and team! Robin is very honest person and the prices were more than fair. I will definitely use them again, they know their business

reviews.author: Peggy Sicheneder
reviews.text: Sands Tree Service was recommended by several people and they did an outstanding job; met and exceeded all expectations! Very professional and courteous! I’m definitely using their services again!

reviews.author: Gayla Warrener
reviews.text: Sands Tree Service could not have been better. They dropped five mature River Birches, three leaning over a new roof. Their 8 or so person team was highly coordinated and led by two very experienced TLs who communicated to the team via wireless helmets. Because of their expertise, coordination and professionalism, they were done in one hour dropping the trees, as my family is doing the clean up. Sands was amazing to watch and were very reasonably priced. My family and I highly recommend them and will definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Brian Goodman
reviews.text: Outstanding job from the first call to get an estimate till the completion of the job! Very professional and organized, very respectful and excellent job!!! Thanks guys for the quick response. This is our second time using them and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Dulcinea Sweeney
reviews.text: Excellent organization that goes above and beyond. Quick to respond with reasonable rates and fabulous customer service. Two day turnaround from my initial call to job completion, even with heavy volume from recent storm damages. Added their number to my quick dial list and would highly recommend them for any of your tree needs.

reviews.author: Lakesidepark Church of God
reviews.text: We used Sands Tree Service to remove a huge tree that had been damaged by lightening. Mr. Sands and his crew were professional and courteous. Their work and attention to detail are impeccable. Highly recommend Sands Tree Service.

reviews.author: Ronald Callicutt
reviews.text: The service was great. They did an excellent job, clean up and all! They even made sure to put back bird houses that had to come down in order to do their job. Cost was very reasonable and we intend to use them again in the future!

reviews.author: Kerry Justice
reviews.text: Requested an estimate two weeks ago to cut two fir trees back below the gutters at the front of the house, and trim two large trees in the front yard that are probably just overgrown bushes, but are as large as trees. The estimator told me he could possibly work my job in by the following Friday. He could reach all of my trees since they were near the driveway. Sure enough, the gent who provided the estimate shows up early with his crew and does a great job. I was most surprised at the excellent cleanup that the crew did. Nothing that was cut down was left behind. I’ll use this company again, and highly recommend them.

reviews.author: cindy Roddy
reviews.text: Robin Sands and his team did a very professional job!!!! Was VERY PLEASED with all the tree work!!!! Highly Recommend!!!!

reviews.author: Katlin Jones
reviews.text: Huge shout out to sands tree service for rescuing my sweet kitty from a tree!! They were so nice and careful as well.

reviews.author: Angie James (Snowangel)
reviews.text: They took down and removed several very large trees and did an awesome job. Very professional. May have to wait but they are worth it.

reviews.author: Matthew Hogan
reviews.text: They did an excellent job. I would use them again hands down. I would recommend them to any and everybody.
